The '''Tarlam Oasis''' was the northern district of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tarlam]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], and the site of the [[Tarlam Oasis Cantina]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tarlam Oasis appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
